notes: εἰσήλθομεν keeps only its verb word because the expressed εἰς answers to the preverb and takes into — rule 106's arm that rule 36 forces.
τῷ before Παύλῳ is unrepresented: the ASV makes Paul the English subject and writes neither determiner nor case preposition (rules 21, 23).
The ASV's textual note records only an inserted longer reading the projection does not carry, so no token is stranded and rule 97 does not arise.
